use_case_summary: Primary: IDE copilot + code completion with real-time token streaming. Secondary: batch reranking of code snippets for PR automation. Needs: low cold-start token latency, stable model pinning per workspace, and predictable throughput during 9-18 PST dev hours.
technical_requirements: Latency SLO: start-of-stream < 100ms for single-line completions; median token latency < 80ms. Throughput target: sustained 600-1,000 concurrent interactive sessions (estimated 900 req/min at 1-3 tokens/ms). Burst policy: up to 2x sustained for 2-hour windows during releases. Model pinning: per-workspace model version locking and deterministic rollouts. Networking: VPC peering + NAT for egress; support for private control plane. KMS for customer keys. Audit log streaming to customer's SIEM.
competitive_notes: Customer trialed OpenAI for latency but experienced jitter at scale; Anthropic suggested server-side batching which increased tail latency. Replit offered an integrated IDE but lacked model-version guarantees. IdeFlux values Redwood's explicit capacity models and rollout controls.
procurement_notes: Procurement will need vendor contract review and SOC2 artifacts. Expect standard POC agreement followed by 12-month reserved capacity contract. Finance prefers quarterly invoicing but can do annual for discount.
communication_preferences: Primary contact: Lead Eng (Priya) via Slack and Fireflies transcripts. Exec sponsor prefers quarterly syncs. Use email thread: thread:1772a-ideflux-sales for formal docs.
